you.title: About you
you.subtitle: What xopc understands about you, where it came from, and what you control.
you.helpSubtitle: A single place to understand how xopc learns and how you stay in control.
you.helpLearningBody: xopc summarizes useful, relatively stable context from conversations and connected sources. Temporary emotions are used for the moment and do not automatically become lasting labels.
you.helpSharingBody: Confirmed understanding is shared with every agent, but only referenced when it is relevant to the current task.
you.helpSourcesBody: Only connections designed to provide personal context appear here. Tools used only to take actions remain under Connectors, and permissions are shown before you connect.
you.helpControlBody: You can confirm, correct, delete, export, or stop learning at any time. Sensitive context and action boundaries follow the choices under Permissions & privacy and never expand existing permissions.
you.memoryHint: Manage what you entered directly alongside context xopc summarized, is waiting for your review, or you already confirmed.
you.meetSuggestedBody: This is a possible name from the computer running xopc. Confirm it or replace it with the name or nickname you prefer.
you.meetBody: Tell xopc how you would like to be addressed. This one small detail makes future collaboration feel more natural.
you.meetPlaceholder: For example: Alex, Joyce, or Mic
you.meetSource: From the computer running xopc; it is saved only after you confirm.
you.meetSaved: Got it, {{name}}. I'll use that name from now on.
you.emptyPlaybooks: No collaboration rules yet. Add preferences and boundaries under Remembered.
you.newRulePlaceholder: Write a rule you want xopc to follow…

playbookRuleExamples.communication: For example: Lead with the conclusion; ask before deleting anything or sending something externally.
playbookRuleExamples.execution: For example: Complete straightforward tasks directly; when options exist, explain the tradeoffs and recommend one.
playbookRuleExamples.routines: For example: Every Friday, summarize this week's progress and list the three most important tasks for next week.

you.profileHint: Things you choose to tell xopc directly.
you.notesPlaceholder: Keep only accessibility needs or durable background here. Use the categorized options below for working style, boundaries, and current priorities.
you.addPreferenceHint: Describe how you prefer xopc to communicate or work.
you.addBoundaryHint: Record a rule that should always be followed or confirmed first.
you.addCurrentFocusHint: Capture something important now that may change over time.
you.addOtherHint: Capture an important person, routine, or long-term direction.
you.understandingHint: Stable preferences and context that can improve future work.
you.consentHint: A recent request matched an item that xopc must not use until you approve it.

understandingPlaceholders.preference: For example: When I’m weighing options, show the tradeoffs before recommending one.
understandingPlaceholders.boundary: For example: Ask before sending messages, deleting content, or spending money.
understandingPlaceholders.relationship: For example: Alex leads my project, so release timing should be confirmed with them.
understandingPlaceholders.routine: For example: Every Friday afternoon, summarize progress and list next week's top three priorities.
understandingPlaceholders.current_state: For example: My most important focus this quarter is completing the public launch.
understandingPlaceholders.long_term_goal: For example: Over the next two years, I want to move toward independent product development.

you.understandingKind: What kind of context is this?
you.conflictsHint: I found understandings that may no longer agree. I won’t use the unresolved alternatives.
you.grantsHint: These understandings may be referenced without asking again. You can revoke access at any time.
you.reviewHint: These are inferred or need another look before they should guide future work.
you.nothingToReviewHint: xopc will bring uncertain or aging understanding here instead of quietly relying on it.
you.emptyUnderstanding: There is nothing here yet. xopc will learn only from useful, durable context as you work together.
you.evidenceRuleValue: {{events}} distinct events across {{days}} days in the last {{window}} days
you.supportModeHint: Choose the response style that feels most useful. Auto adapts between listening, reflection, advice, and action.
you.collaborationHint: Manage response style, proactive suggestions, quiet hours, and collaboration rules every agent should follow.
you.forgetBody: It will be removed and will no longer be used as personal context.
you.sourcesSubtitle: Connect the accounts you use so xopc can build reviewable understanding in the background.
you.sourceNeedsAttention: Fix the connection before learning can continue
you.sourceStillLearning: Found {{count}} items related to you and is still building stable understanding
you.sourceNoPersonalSignal: Checked {{count}} items; none were directly related to you yet
you.sourceNoRecentSignal: No recent information related to you was found
you.sourcePreparing: Connected and preparing to learn about this account
you.sourceRecentRunSummary: Read {{indexed}} recent items; {{attributed}} were directly related to you and formed {{claims}} reliable understandings.
you.sourceReadAccess: Reads a limited set of recent information to understand work and habits related to you.
you.sourceMemoryAccess: Only stable, traceable information can become lasting understanding.
you.sourceNoWriteAccess: Background learning never changes or sends content.
you.sourceWriteAccess: The connection supports write actions, but background learning only reads and never changes or sends content.
you.sourcePurposeWork: Understand the projects, collaborators, and current work that involve you.
you.sourcePurposeCommunication: Recognize collaborators and ongoing topics in communication related to you.
you.sourcePurposeSchedule: Understand your work rhythm, plans, and important collaboration from your schedule.
you.sourcePurposeDocuments: Recognize durable projects, topics, and working patterns in documents you use.
you.sourcePurposeDefault: Learn context related to you from recent activity in this account.
you.connectedClaimsHint: Independent evidence is accumulated before a reviewable, traceable claim is formed.
you.claimProject: You have recently contributed repeatedly to {{label}}
you.claimRoutine: You often schedule calendar activity on {{weekday}} around {{hour}}:00 UTC
you.claimRule: Only deduplicated independent activities count; relationships and projects require 2 days, routines require 3 days.
you.disconnectBody: After disconnecting {{source}}, xopc will stop receiving new context from it. Choose what should happen to existing understanding.
you.disconnectImpact: This account currently contributes {{items}} source items and {{understandings}} derived understandings.
you.disconnectKeepBody: Existing understanding stays available, and you can still correct or forget each item.
you.disconnectDeleteBody: Delete {{count}} understandings from this source, including archived or rejected records. This cannot be undone.
you.disconnectDeleted: The source was disconnected and {{count}} understandings were deleted.
you.noSources: No personal context sources are available yet.
you.trustTitle: How far xopc may act by default
you.trustHint: Choose the default boundary for everyday actions. Individual automations and connections can be authorized separately without silently expanding access.

trustLevelHints.suggest: Explain a recommendation and let you decide.
trustLevelHints.confirm: Prepare the action and request approval first.

you.autoConfirmTitle: Allow automatic action within approved boundaries?
you.autoConfirmBody: xopc may use write-enabled connectors or workflows to complete routine actions automatically. It cannot expand existing permissions, and high-risk actions still require confirmation.
you.controlHint: Choose how xopc learns and how carefully sensitive context is handled.
you.privacyHint: Control separately what xopc may remember, what it may reference, and how far it may act by default.

sensitiveOptionHints.deny: Sensitive details are not stored as personal context.
sensitiveOptionHints.confirm: xopc asks before saving or referencing sensitive details.
sensitiveOptionHints.allow: Sensitive details may be used only when relevant to the current task.

you.sharingHint: Confirmed items are part of your global personal context. Every enabled agent may read them when relevant to the current task. This does not grant new connector or action permissions.
you.importConfirmBody: “{{name}}” will not overwrite your basics. New understanding enters the review queue, while duplicates and invalid items are skipped. Files are limited to 2 MB and 500 understandings.
you.importSuccess: Imported {{count}} understandings and skipped {{skipped}}. Please review each one.
you.importError: This file could not be imported. Make sure it is an xopc About You export within the size limit.
you.loadError: Could not load what xopc knows about you.
